_doc: Nebula AI bundled model manifest — single authority for the pinned HuggingFace model URL, SHA-256, filename, and metadata. Consumed at build time by stage_nebula_model() in scripts/build-iso.sh and at boot time indirectly via the MANIFEST.sha256 generated from this source. DEC-PHASE10-002 (model selection: Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3 Q4_K_M, Apache-2.0), DEC-PHASE10-008 (HF staging + ORIONX_MODEL_LOCAL air-gap fallback).
_integrity_note: model_sha256 is 'TBD-VERIFY-AT-DOWNLOAD' — the first successful build will compute the real SHA-256 from the downloaded file and a follow-up commit will pin the verified value. This is the standard trust-on-first-use pattern with subsequent integrity lockdown (DEC-PHASE10-008). Once verified, the SHA-256 must be a 64-char lowercase hex string.
_size_note: model_size_bytes is the expected on-disk size of the Q4_K_M GGUF (approximately 4.4 GB). The ISO size jumps from ~1.8 GB (rc4) to ~6 GB with this model bundled (DEC-PHASE10-003 target). A WARN (not fail) is emitted by build-iso.sh if the final ISO exceeds 7 GB (DEC-PHASE10-012).
